 If going on crime sprees in Grand Theft Auto VI isn’t for you, we have good news: Amazon has already launched early Black Friday PS5 game deals. During the sale, you can save up to 59% on some of the biggest PlayStation titles.
 Notable discounted games include Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition ( $49.99) , Marvel’s Wolverine ($49.97),  and  Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition ($39.99), with sports titles like  NBA 2K27 ($29.99),  Madden NFL 27 ($34.97), and FC 27 ($34.97) also heavily discounted.
 Shop PS5 Black Friday Deals at Amazon 
 Advertisement 
 You can also get the following hits for $30 or less: The Last of Us Part I ,  Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 , God of War Ragnarök , Returnal , and Horizon Forbidden West Complete Edition . See a more complete list of PS5 game deals below.
 Related Video 
 For the best Black Friday shopping experience, we recommend signing up for an Amazon Prime 30-day free trial , which gives you access to fast, free shipping, exclusive deals, and unlimited streaming of Prime Video TV and movies.
 Head to our Black Friday 2026 hub for more sales, including the best deals on  AirPods , noise-canceling headphones , portable Bluetooth speakers , and iPads . Plus, see details on Amazon’s Criterion Collection 50% off event .
